interpretation: A draft freshness contract detects missing or stale verifier/packet hashes and stale result schema, while the unchanged current packet remains valid. The draft is not integrated.
limitations: This does not prove historical PASS artifacts were produced by the claimed verifier.
Freshness binding does not solve semantic schema or formula correctness.
No provider, cloud, canonical, protected, or production state was accessed or changed.
reopen_trigger: Independent review and explicit adoption of a versioned verifier-result contract.
